title: Add discriminating watcher drain filtering coverage after ingress had no known roots
outcome: A behavioral witness proves the current-state drain filters ignored descendants that were conservatively retained by ingress with an empty root cache, without publishing, attributing or notifying Engram about them.
acceptance: Ingest target/, node_modules/ and .git descendant file events into an empty-root pending structure, assert they are retained, then drain against a known session root.
The drain produces no publication, no active-turn file change and no Engram workspace-change observation for those ignored descendants; an ordinary source control stays observable.
